methodologyNotes: This dataset covers ten electric multicookers (Instant Pot-style pressure + slow + rice combo units, including air-fry hybrid models), drawn from manufacturer product pages (instantpot.com, cosori.com, breville.com), major retailer listings (Target, Best Buy, Amazon, Walmart), and third-party spec aggregators (discounttoday.net, ntelectronic.com). Prices reflect the US MSRP or lowest confirmed published retail price found during research; where official MSRP was unavailable, the lowest verified new-unit price from a major retailer is used with a note. Capacity is in US quarts; pressure is gauge PSI (high-pressure setting, top of the published range); air_fry is a boolean (true = device includes an air-fry lid or function). All values independently re-verified 2026-06-19; manufacturer-page prices confirmed for the Instant Pot Duo, Duo Plus, Rio, COSORI, and Breville; retailer/aggregator prices confirmed for the rest. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
